Each option is either one tappable element currently on screen (its label is quoted) or a meta action. Pick the element most likely to lead toward the goal. Do NOT require a literal word match: section names, tabs, tiles and synonyms count (e.g. the goal 'Open Settings' is served by a 'More' tab when no 'Settings' element is visible). Pick the option stating the goal is ALREADY achieved when `screen.selected` / `screen.visible_texts` show that - do not act again. Pick the option stating that none of the elements lead toward the goal when nothing can plausibly advance it, or when progress would require typing text, paying, or confirming a purchase. Pick a scroll option only if the needed element is probably off-screen. Never repeat an action that `history` says produced no change. `screen.selected` names the currently selected tab; a tab label being visible in the bottom bar does NOT mean that tab is open - tap it to open it. Tapping a tab or section is free and reversible.
